purpose: Require the existing server-authoritative CONTROL_PLANE staff access session and STAFF_REQUEST_APPROVE grant on production P0 registration decisions.
requiredInvariants: Registration decisions require an active server-resolved staff access session.
Only CONTROL_PLANE mode with STAFF_REQUEST_APPROVE can authorize the decision endpoint.
The durable staff assignment permission is rechecked before the decision executes.
The follow-up branch cannot edit this scope contract, its checker, or the protected guard workflow.
